schema.text: Do speed bumps and similar features make you feel safer when you ride?
schema.help: Features that slow traffic down, such as speed bumps, rumble strips, raised crossings or road markings.

en.#Do speed bumps and similar features mak: Do speed bumps and similar features make you feel safer when you ride?
en.#Features that slow traffic down, such a: Features that slow traffic down, such as speed bumps, rumble strips, raised crossings or road markings.

it.#Do speed bumps and similar features mak: Dossi e simili ti fanno sentire più al sicuro quando guidi?
it.#Features that slow traffic down, such a: Elementi che rallentano il traffico, come dossi, bande sonore, attraversamenti rialzati o segnaletica a terra.

fr.#Do speed bumps and similar features mak: Les ralentisseurs et dispositifs semblables vous font-ils vous sentir plus en sécurité quand vous roulez ?
fr.#Features that slow traffic down, such a: Des aménagements qui ralentissent la circulation, comme des ralentisseurs, des bandes sonores, des passages surélevés ou des marquages au sol.

de.#Do speed bumps and similar features mak: Geben Ihnen Bodenwellen und Ähnliches mehr Sicherheit beim Fahren?
de.#Features that slow traffic down, such a: Dinge, die den Verkehr bremsen, etwa Bodenwellen, Rüttelstreifen, erhöhte Übergänge oder Fahrbahnmarkierungen.

tr.#Do speed bumps and similar features mak: Hız kesiciler ve benzeri düzenlemeler sürerken kendinizi daha güvende hissettiriyor mu?
tr.#Features that slow traffic down, such a: Trafiği yavaşlatan düzenlemeler; örneğin hız kesiciler, uyarı çizgileri, yükseltilmiş geçitler veya yol işaretleri.

fa.#Do speed bumps and similar features mak: آیا سرعت‌گیر و موارد مشابه باعث می‌شود هنگام سواری احساس امنیت بیشتری کنید؟
fa.#Features that slow traffic down, such a: ابزارهایی که سرعت ترافیک را کم می‌کنند، مثل سرعت‌گیر، نوار هشداردهنده، گذرگاه بلندشده یا خط‌کشی جاده.

hu.#Do speed bumps and similar features mak: Biztonságosabbnak érzi a közlekedést a fekvőrendőröktől és hasonló megoldásoktól?
hu.#Features that slow traffic down, such a: Olyan megoldások, amelyek lassítják a forgalmat, például fekvőrendőr, rázósáv, kiemelt gyalogátkelő vagy útburkolati jelzések.

ar.#Do speed bumps and similar features mak: هل تجعلك المطبات وما يشبهها تشعر بأمان أكبر عندما تقود؟
ar.#Features that slow traffic down, such a: وسائل تُبطئ حركة المرور، مثل المطبات أو الشرائط المهتزة أو المعابر المرتفعة أو خطوط الطريق.
